subject: Verdant: Hosted->Dedicated migration & sizing kickoff
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@verdant.ai>
Cc: Paula Torres <paula.torres@verdant.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Verdant: Hosted->Dedicated migration & sizing kickoff

Hi Evan / Paula,

Congrats again on the Reserved Capacity commitment — excited to get Verdant onto a dedicated pool. To make the cutover smooth we need a quick sizing/validation pass so infra can provision the right GPU mix and we can map acceptance gates to dates. Can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday?

- 30-day average and peak qps for text-generation endpoints (tokens/s and requests/s). If you can attach a 7-day hourly CSV, that helps.
- Model families used in production (names + typical prompt lengths & max seq).
- Any heavy embedding/rerank jobs that run on schedule (daily batch jobs and their window).
- Desired cutover week (we typically recommend a 2–3 day window for canary + swap).

I'll draft a proposed validation timeline based on your numbers and loop in Marissa (infrastructure), Neha (SRE acceptance) and Ben (solutions) to confirm resource sizing and fallbacks.

Attachments: none yet — please attach the load profile if possible.

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0117

From: Evan Li <evan.li@verdant.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Paula Torres <paula.torres@verdant.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Verdant: Hosted->Dedicated migration & sizing kickoff

Hi Rohan — thanks, and excited to get this moving. Attached a 7-day hourly extract (verdant_load_profile.csv) and our signed PO (verdant_purchase_order_1174.pdf). Summary below:

- Production endpoints (Nov 1 snapshot):
  - text-gen-primary (redwood-coder-xl): average 60 req/s, 95th 220 req/s, typical prompt length ~750 tokens, max 2048 tokens.
  - chat-assistant (redwood-chat-medium): average 40 req/s, 95th 130 req/s, typical prompt ~400 tokens.
  - embeddings-bulk (batch at 02:00 UTC): 25k docs / day, spreads across 3h window.
- Peak window is 14:00–16:00 PST weekdays.
- SLA target: p50 < 200ms for small prompts, p95 < 800ms; we care about tail during peak.
- Cutover preference: week of Nov 20 — minimal business impact then.

Let me know if you need any historical kv cache hit rates or example prompt distributions.

Best,
Evan
Evan Li
Head of ML Engineering, Verdant Analytics
evan.li@verdant.ai
Attachment: verdant_load_profile.csv (csv), verdant_purchase_order_1174.pdf (pdf)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@verdant.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Paula Torres <paula.torres@verdant.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Verdant: Hosted->Dedicated migration & sizing kickoff

Thanks Evan — the CSV is helpful. Drafting a compact validation and cutover timeline below. Attaching a PDF with proposed GPU counts + schedule. Please review the milestones and call out any hard constraints.

Proposed minimal acceptance path (high level):
1) Provisioning: reserve 4 x A100-80GB for redwood-coder-xl serving + 2 x A10G for smaller chat model + 2 x T4 nodes for overnight embedding batch. (Provisional numbers — will refine with infra.)
2) Staging rehearse (3 days): deploy identical model builds to staging dedicated tenant, run perf smoke across peak hour replay. SRE verifies KV cache behavior and memory.
3) Throughput acceptance (2 days): 95th latency verification and throughput ramp to 100% of expected peak for each endpoint. Success criteria: p95 <= 800ms for text-gen-primary under standard request mix.
4) Canary swap (6–8 hours): route 10% of live traffic to dedicated pool, monitor for errors/regression, then 50% then full. Rollback on error thresholds.
5) Final swap (1–2 hour window): DNS/traffic switch and post-cutover verification.

Proposed timeline if we start provisioning Nov 9:
- Nov 9–11: infra provisioning + kernel compilation/quantization profile selection
- Nov 12–14: staging rehearse + smoke tests
- Nov 15–16: throughput acceptance
- Nov 20: canary + incremental ramp (target low-traffic day)
- Nov 21: final cutover (fallback plan ready)

Primary asks from Verdant: a staging traffic replay (ideally the CSV provided) and confirmation that the Nov 20–21 window is acceptable.

Attachment: proposed_sizing_and_schedule.pdf (pdf)

I'll hand this to Marissa and Neha for confirmation on GPU mix and SRE acceptance criteria.

Regards,
Rohan

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Action: Verdant sizing validation & infra ask (need numbers by EOD Nov 6)

Folks — looping you in to lock down resource commitments for the Verdant swap (Deal VD-2026-1174). Evan sent load profiles and requested the Nov 20–21 cutover window. High-level asks: 

- Marissa: can infra provision (or reserve) 4x A100-80GB GPUs (single tenant) + 2x A10G and 2x T4 nodes in us-west region? Also need kernel/compilation pass for the redwood-coder-xl build (seq len 2048). Please call out lead time and if we need any special node shapes.
- Neha: can SRE own the throughput acceptance criteria and define the exact error thresholds & rollback triggers? Need a checklist we can share with Verdant (p95 latency, error rate, cache warm-up).
- Ben: solutions to validate prompt distribution while minimizing prefix cache cold-starts — can you run a replay job that hits staging during our rehearsal window and report token-level latencies?

Deadline: please reply with 'ACK' and any blockers by EOD Nov 6 so we can confirm dates with customer.

Thanks,
Rohan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Action: Verdant sizing validation & infra ask (need numbers by EOD Nov 6)

ACK — quick replies and notes:

- Provisioning: we can reserve the 4x A100-80GB + 2x A10G + 2x T4s in us-west. Lead time: 5 business days to get nodes fully commissioned + kernel build. That fits the Nov 9 planned start if approvals (PO / docuSign) are in place this week.
- Kernel/quantization: recommend we compile fp16 kernels for redwood-coder-xl, and run a mixed-precision validation. If Verdant is ok with int8 for embeddings batch, we can drop TCO on embedding nodes. Note: int8 needs a brief regression check against quality baseline (we'll schedule a 1-day QA run).
- SRE acceptance / rollback triggers (draft):
  - Acceptance: p95 text-gen-primary <= 800ms while sustaining 110% of expected peak for 30min
  - Error thresholds: >0.5% 5xxs over 5min triggers immediate rollback to hosted tier
  - Cache warm-up: expect 15–25% cold penalty during first 30 minutes; we will run warm-up replay for 1 hour.
- Ops links: INF ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4592 (provisioning + cutover runbook).

Next steps I need from Sales/Legal: final signed contract link (DocuSign) so we can move nodes into reserved state. Once PO/DocuSign is in, infra will start Nov 9 and staging runs Nov 12–14, throughput acceptance Nov 15–16, canary Nov 20, final cutover Nov 21.

Marissa Cole
Head of Infra, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
